calls.title: Jonathan Asher and Jake Heier
calls.summary: Jake Heier (account manager) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) from GrowthBook discussed the platform’s sandbox setup, integrations with Segment/Mixpanel, and advanced experimentation features (multi-armed bandits, Bayesian methods) with Rob Shields (insights lead), Jonathan Asher (product analyst), and Kevin Washington (director of carrier technology). Key pain points included underpowered tests, data warehouse access concerns
